scope: Installed Ares Audio_Load loop, paired BAG admission/IDX layout, casefold sort/merge and original FindSampleIndex, bounded synthetic component execution.
assumptions: Synthetic CCFile transport objects and pre-opened bags are inputs; native MIX resolver, OS handles, whole startup/hook installer, driver and audible output are not executed.

Open controls supply byte-exact synthetic files, Exists/Open outcomes and read transfer. The actual DLL tests read lengths, owns paired admission and sorts metadata. Malformed sizes large enough to exhaust memory are outside scope.
Merge controls supply existing entry arrays and opaque file tokens; actual native casefold tree merge overwrites complete metadata and backing file, then original FindSampleIndex executes.
No whole mechanism or audio RNG/mixer parity is claimed; no mod payloads are used. All selected text is checked unchanged by CountryFixture. Existing fixture rejects RNG and detach entries.
substitutions: Reuses public CountryFixture/Probe image mapping, arena, call execution and heap leaves; no second VM owner.
Additional game allocator10001B60 and delete100033C0 are heap boundaries. CCFile ctor/Exists/Open/Read/destructor are declared in-memory transport leaves.
Bounded snprintf for literal %s.idx, %s.bag and audio%02d is supplied. Thus order control proves loop bounds/order, not formatter equivalence.
